ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-gray pixels and 35% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region exhibits a high-intensity white core. This is bounded by a low-intensity black continuous band along the trailing edge and lateral tips. The inferior boundaries show extensive grayscale mottling with high-frequency stochastic pixel distribution.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped notch with an estimated aperture of 45-55 degrees; notch depth is approximately 15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-amplitude serrations. Presence of multiple filamentous or 'tassel-like' low-intensity protrusions extending vertically from the edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal (S-shaped) curve characterized by concave medial segments near the notch transitioning into convex distal segments terminating in sharp lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of small, circular white pixel clusters (rosettes) localized within the low-intensity mottled zones on the lower-left and lower-right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple dark, vertical linear streaks extending downwards from the trailing edge; fine-line diagonal disruptions are visible across the high-intensity central white region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable 'tasseling' effect along the trailing edge consisting of irregular dark tissue or parasitic protrusions; extensive surface pitting/scars visible in the lower quadrant mottling.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical pigment 'drips' or streaks concentrated around the medial notch area, extending into the high-intensity white zone.
